title: 'Ilm al-huruf
text:
'Ilm al-huruf
'Ilm al-huruf
ʿIlm al-Ḥurūf
(
Arabic
:
عِلْم الْحُرُوف
) or
the science of letters
, also called Islamic
letterism
, is a process of Arabic
numerology
whereby numerical values assigned to
Arabic letters
are added up to provide total values for words in the
Quran
, similar to Hebrew
gematria
. Used to infer meanings and reveal secret or hidden messages.
ʿIlm al-Ḥurūf is composed of the two words
ʿilm
(
Arabic
:
عِلْم
) meaning "knowledge", and
ḥurūf
(
Arabic
:
حُرُوف
), the plural of the word
ḥarf
(
Arabic
:
حَرْف
), meaning "letters".
